C5H8O2 DBE 2: possibilities: pent-2-enoic acid (C5H8O2) has DBE 2 (one C=O, one C=C). Aromatic carbons 2? Not aromatic. So maybe the data about aromatic carbons is wrong.

We need fragments: maybe "CC(=O)C" and "C=C". But need SMILES strings for connected fragments of the compound. Could be two fragments that join: "CC(=O)C" (isobutyl?) and "C=C". Not sure.
